# Model results (generated by `python -m bixi.models`)

Hourly departures and arrivals at the 50 study stations, forecast up to 24 hours ahead.
Backtest: four monthly folds (June-September 2025). Holdout: 2025-10-01 to 2025-11-15,
evaluated once. Skill = MAE reduction versus the seasonal naive baseline
(same hour last week).

## Backtest

### Departures

| Model | MAE | RMSE | Poisson deviance | Skill vs naive | 80% coverage | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| lgbm_poisson_all_years | 2.456 | 3.970 | 1.952 | 25.5% |  | adds 2023 (temperature-only forecasts) |
| lgbm_poisson_oracle | 2.467 | 3.968 | 1.948 | 25.1% |  | observed weather: upper bound, not deployable |
| lgbm_poisson | 2.473 | 4.018 | 1.981 | 25.0% |  | main model |
| lgbm_tweedie | 2.511 | 4.048 | 2.019 | 23.8% |  | objective comparison |
| lgbm_l2 | 2.539 | 4.057 | 2.107 | 22.9% |  | objective comparison |
| lgbm_poisson_no_weather | 2.638 | 4.339 | 2.240 | 19.9% |  | value of weather forecasts |
| same_hour_4w | 2.877 | 4.760 | 4.581 | 12.7% |  | baseline |
| profile_mean | 2.925 | 4.994 | 2.901 | 11.2% |  | baseline |
| seasonal_naive | 3.295 | 5.510 | 13.404 | 0.0% |  | baseline |

## Top features (main model, holdout, share of gain)
